name: Continental Divide Trail
region: United States (Waterton Lake to Crazy Cook)
description: The Continental Divide Trail, from the Waterton Lake border monument to the Crazy Cook monument on the Mexican border. 3029 miles measured along the full-resolution centreline; 3038 miles in the CDTC's own published mileage, which is what the "Official mile N" waypoints are numbered in. Built from the CDTC's FeatureServer centreline with Copernicus GLO-30 elevation on every vertex. The track in this file is decimated to 3000 miles to fit the point budget, so distances computed from it run about 0.97% short of both.
